title: Microsoft Teams: separate invites for town hall attendees, presenters and co-organizers
notes: claim 44: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The rollout windows, automatic delivery, admin path and email-editing command are supported. The risk rationale should say that no new data access is described, rather than asserting there is none; January dates should remain expectations, and the policy reference's preview qualification should be noted.

claims.claim: This Microsoft Teams change separates town hall attendee invites from the events crew through a backend change.
claims.quote: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew.

claims.claim: No admin UI or automation switch for role-based invitation separation is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams town hall separate invites admin setting disable; Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy separate invites attendee town hall AllowEmailEditing. Opened manage-email-communications, plan-events and Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy; none documents an invitation-separation switch.

claims.claim: The event email editing path is Teams admin center > Meetings > Events policies > policy > Customize event emails.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Events policies. 2. Select an existing policy or create a new one. 3. Turn the Customize event emails toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowEmailEditing Disabled disables email-template editing.
claims.quote: The following example turns off -AllowEmailEditing so organizers and co-organizers can't edit email templates: Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowEmailEditing Disabled
claims.fix: Keep the command. Add to controls[1].note: 'The Set-CsTeamsEventsPolicy reference labels the policy as preview.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamseventspolicy?view=teams-ps, which states 'Note that this policy is currently still in preview.' The cited email-management guide does not carry that qualification.

claims.claim: The event email editing control is a user-level policy.
claims.quote: User-level policy for tenant admin to configure options for customizing Teams events experiences.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamseventspolicy?view=teams-ps to sources; this also supplies the reference for the preview note on the command.

claims.claim: The general email control governs whether organizers and co-organizers can edit event email templates, rather than selecting invitation recipients.
claims.quote: You can control whether event organizers and co-organizers can edit email templates for their events.
